verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's marketing site says cases move between agents and the team and that every decision stays defensible. It also says the product can screen customers and disposition alerts using automation, and the docs describe an automatic audit trail of all work. These are only high-level claims, with no documentation of an in-product agent reviewing screening matches or recording its rationale. Missing for 10: documentation of an agent that reviews screening matches, how agent rationale is captured per decision, human override/approval of agent dispositions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to review screening matches with recorded rationale

citations.quote: It automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team, and keeps every decision defensible.
Screen customers and disposition alerts more intelligently.
This feature ensures that you have comprehensive audits of all work that occurs in Hummingbird.
